title: Short A Worksheets | Kindergarten Phonics Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: RF.K.2d, RF.K.3, RF.K.3b, RF.K.4

Give your learners extra practice with Short A! This no-prep printable pack has 6 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (9 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Short a: Which Word?
  • Build Short a Words
  • Short a Match
  • -at or -an?
  • Sam the Cat
  • Pam and the Ram
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Short a: Which Word?, Build Short a Words, Short a Match, -at or -an?, Sam the Cat, Pam and the Ram), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Phonics & Reading Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
